excluded_inputs.reason: OHLCV-only indicator fixture has no recorded timestamps; chronological and event-clock validation is unavailable

contract.liquidity: unconstrained fills at the recorded close; volume participation is not modeled
contract.timing: signal at close t holds close t to close t+1; final evaluated close liquidates
contract.settlement: one additional real source bar; excluded from evaluation and strategy preparation
contract.parity: every equity sample, held bar, fill bar, side and price; independent cash replay and Limen
contract.costed_comparison: unsupported: legacy snapshot entry-fee accounting differs from affordable cash-spot sizing
contract.timing_scopes: engine API; API plus common equity/fills/summary extraction; Limen full snapshot separately
contract.cold: fresh process and unique empty Numba disk cache; imports/preparation reported separately
contract.memory: process high-water RSS, including imports and preparation; not allocation-only engine memory
contract.comparison_limit: public APIs perform unequal additional native work; no universal engine ranking
contract.batch_scope: each column has its own initial cash and accounting; Limen serial calls versus one vectorbt matrix call; no cash sharing
contract.tail_statistic_limit: p95 is a sample percentile; few repeats do not establish tail latency
